project: Reconstructing Hidden Process Transformations with LLMs from Selected Quantitative Evidence
purpose: Selected experiment code, structured evidence, configurations, prompts, and saved model responses.

code.pipeline: Evidence construction and API execution, including retained historical versions.
code.scoring: Scoring implementations; grading inputs and aggregate results are not included in this snapshot.

contents.configurations: Archived run metadata and experimental operating settings.
contents.data: Structured evidence, annotations, manifests, and source documentation encoded as JSON; raw event-log archives are excluded.
contents.runs: Saved API responses under runs/<experiment>/responses/, together with a response index.

table_format: Files ending in .csv.json encode table columns and rows as JSON. They are not CSV files and cannot be read directly with csv.DictReader.
usage: This is an archival snapshot. Historical scripts may require path adjustments, external raw datasets, and dependencies from the original experimental environment. No release.py restoration utility is included.
limitations: The LaTeX manuscript and figures are excluded.
Raw event logs, analysis scripts, grading outputs, and aggregate results are not included in this snapshot.
Historical paths in code and metadata may refer to files outside this repository.
Model responses and provenance are preserved as archived; they do not imply every historical pipeline runs standalone.
